title: Troubleshooting Decision Tree
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: Troubleshooting
Debugging
Decision Tree
Hardware Testing
description: Interactive Mermaid troubleshooting decision tree for Pico clocks. Students pick one of five symptom families, follow yes and no questions with the test to run at each step, and reach a suggested fix and the chapter to review, with a breadcrumb of their path.

educational.topic: Systematic troubleshooting of Pico clock projects
learningObjectives: Analyze a symptom and select the most likely cause
Choose the next test that best splits the remaining possible causes
Explain why power and wiring are checked before code

pedagogical.teachingStrategy: Guided case studies through a decision tree
keyQuestions: What is the cheapest test that rules out the most causes?
How does a whole-hour time error differ from drift?
commonMisconceptions: A blank screen always means broken code (power and wiring are more common causes)
Random resets are always hardware (a crash and restart looks the same)
assessmentOpportunities: Record the path and fix for written case studies
Design a new question and test for the tree

controls.label: Click any box
controls.description: Selects that question or fix, highlights the path and shows the reasoning and test.
